hypothesis: A better discriminative reward and a larger update budget can improve independent frog recognition without collapsing diversity
sampler: released 50-step leading-schedule fixed_large DDPM, stock-matched zero adapter
classifier_split: CIFAR-10 training set permuted with torch seed 3401, first 25000 proxy and remaining 25000 independent evaluator
classifier_training: 16 epochs, AdamW lr=0.001, batch=128, random crop pad4 and horizontal flip, cosine schedule, no test-set tuning
step_selection: one sampled nonterminal step per each of [0,16), [16,32), [32,49), deterministic from seed/update
primary_effect: trained minus zero on fresh paired seeds, measured by both proxy frog probability and independent evaluator frog probability/accuracy
stopping_rule: No GRPO if either classifier misses 70% test accuracy; stop any seed on nonfinite samples/gradients or action-ratio saturation >50% for five consecutive updates; report failure without modifying completed runs
claim_scope: Exploratory hypothesis prompted by two completed null studies; fresh seeds set before this study's training
